Look for: which file was changed (docs/welcome.md, docs/keyboard-shortcuts.md, or docs/setup-guide.md)? Which challenge was this PR solving? Does the description. Finally, check the conversation - press 3 to jump between comments. Read what the validation bot reported - did the bot find any accessibility issues like broken headings or non-descriptive links? How did the author respond? Think of it as a rail line: each stop confirms you are still on the right route before the next one.

speaker: ALEX
text: Carry the map. Know what page or tool you are in, know which action you are taking, and know what confirmation should follow. If the confirmation is missing, pause. That pause is not wasted time; it is professional judgment.
